highlights: About 100 acres in Chandrasan, near Kalrav Nest: 136 plots on the developer’s sheet; the layout for phases 1 and 2 (R_19.2, Aug 2026) shows 149
Plot sizes of about 1,100 – 3,944 sq.yd (layout: 1,133 – 5,545 sq.yd super built-up)
NA title-clear and Vastu-compliant plots; building on your plot is not compulsory
A fruit orchard made for all the plots, 40 ft internal roads and walking trails
Common plot with bore well, underground tank, pump room and servant quarters
A percolation well at every crossroad and wall space for electricity meters
title: Photos and renders
